headlines.name: Nvidia
headlines.headline: ‘Some things you just don’t take off the menu’: Denny’s stands by Jensen Huang after his Nvidia comeback
headlines.description: When Jensen Huang lost his job as Nvidia’s CEO earlier this month, he also lost his commemorative plaque at Denny’s. Eleven days later, Huang returned to the helm of the chip giant to a rock-star welcome from cheering employees. His plaque, it turns out, beat him to the comeback. Now the restaurant chain has a message for its most famous former dishwasher.
